listing.summary: Adds two custom portraits, one female for Tri-Tachyon and one male for Hegemony.

description:
Mod contains two portraits, one female for Tri-Tachyon and one male for Hegemony. Artist will remain anonymous. It is not permitted to utilise these images or any of the images contained within the mod's file for the training of "AI" algorithms

Spoiler  [close]

Download link:

https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/Commissioned-Portraits/releases/download/starsector/Commissioned.Portraits.zip

Unnecessary backstory:

Spoiler- Doi Ota served in the 2nd AI War. Employee of a random Tibicena corporate cell. Elevated in hierarchy due to scoring exceptionally high in fighter tests. Survived enough engagements to be promoted to officer due to significant casualties suffered by Tri-Tachyon during the overall military conflict. Served for several years before being elevated to a position of a fleet director. Given her own fleet. Operated a trade raiding group in Aztlan successfully intercepting several trade fleets before being captured and executed by the Hegemony. Often portrayed with a pin resembling a Gigacannon. Even though she was not alive at the time the weapon was and is being utilised

- William Shuster served as a Hegemony officer of a long distance patrol that eventually settled to permanently patrol a fringe Hegemony colony of recent origin known as Little/Tiny Person. A water world stuck in a Lagrange point of a temperate gas giant. Has a preference for cruisers. Noted down in the files for "inferiority complex". Kept around in spite of recommendation by psychological evaluation stating not to do so. Origin not specified necessarily, but most likely an Eventide child of a noble's affair abandoned to not upset some unspecified political status quo. No genetic investigation due to possible unforeseen political ramifications. And not falling under possible utility budget of Status Investigation Bureau granted by Legislation 55-8 BAI "Directive to Make Soldiers Whole" emplaced under the rule of President Uranus Synopa of Jangala[close]

Concept art link:

https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/Commissioned-Portraits/releases/download/starsector/concept.art.zip
